name: Grocery Shopping Simulator
source:
The game where you're 100% NOT getting scammed while buying yourself drinks.

This *very* short visual novel follows you, the player, who is a miserable guy who works a miserable job. You're just trying to grab a cold one at the grocery store after a long day of work.

[From [url=https://lestellian.itch.io/grocery-shopping-simulator]itch.io[/url]]
